## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 本 PR 为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`,`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测 GOVERNED、H(人合)),保持 draft;当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),由 skills 席位按 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 做记录审查,通过后席位再请你批准。
改了什么:`objectstack-data` 与 `objectstack-upgrade` 的 SKILL.md 里 8 行 "→ Moved verbatim to …" 指针,以及它们留下的多余 `---`。
data:4 行并入 § Quick Reference 索引,成为带真实锚点的一行条目;Lifecycle Hooks 那行删除,索引里原有的 Lifecycle Hooks 条目(→ `references/data-hooks.md`)就是它的归宿。
upgrade:没有索引,3 行原地换成一行条目,带真实锚点,§2.3、§3.4 编号保持连续。
不改任何规则的教学内容;两个 token 行都缩小(data 6656 → 6654,upgrade 6182 → 6170),`check:skill-links` 验证了全部新锚点。

## What changed

The split that moved worked examples into `references/` (decision batch #213 item 1) left one pointer line per moved block: "→ Moved verbatim to [file](./file) § Heading". Each said where a section went and linked only the file top, and the `---` separators around them doubled up. Measured on `main` 7e8b31ce5: 5 stubs in objectstack-data, 3 in objectstack-upgrade, as the card counted.

- **objectstack-data** has a section index, § Quick Reference — Detailed Rules. Four stubs become entries there in its bullet style, each with a real fragment where the target is a section. The Lifecycle Hooks stub is deleted: the index already has a Lifecycle Hooks entry, and the example section it pointed at itself hands the reader to `references/data-hooks.md`.
- **objectstack-upgrade** has no section index, so each stub becomes a one-line entry in place, linking its heading by fragment. §2.3 and §3.4 stay in their numbered sequence (the Quickstart's "template in §3.4" still lands on the §3.4 entry).
- Orphaned `---` removed: data, one of the pair around the Quick-Start stub and three of the four around the Protection / Seeds / Lint run; upgrade, the second of the pair around the v17 stub.

| data L239 Quick-Start Template stub | § Quick Reference entry → `references/examples-objects.md#quick-start-template` |
| data L367 Lifecycle Hooks stub | existing § Quick Reference **Lifecycle Hooks** entry → `references/data-hooks.md` (seat ruling: no tail added) |
| data L455 Metadata Protection stub | § Quick Reference entry → `references/examples-objects.md#metadata-protection-protection` |
| data L459 Seed Data & Fixtures stub | § Quick Reference entry → `references/seeds.md` |
| data L463 Linting & Generation Quality stub | § Quick Reference entry → `references/lint-rules.md` |
| upgrade L273 §2.3 stub | in-place entry → `references/examples-upgrade.md#23-a-worked-r1--the-retired-field-mapping-transform` |

| upgrade L457 v17 shapes stub | in-place entry → `references/examples-upgrade.md#the-v17-canonical-shapes-compiled` |
| 4 + 1 `---` lines | none needed: separators, no content |

No rule sentence is cut. The stubs carried only a file pointer.

### Anchor and link sweep

- Before: no stub carried a `#fragment`, so none was broken; each landed on its file's top. After: 5 new fragments, all resolved by `pnpm check:skill-links` (250 links, 127 fragments).
- No file in either skill, no `evals/*.json`, and no other skill links into these stub positions (`grep` for `SKILL.md#`, the headings and the reference file names).
- Pins: no `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts` and no `scripts/**` check quotes a stub line. The token-ratchet script's row comments describe the stubs ("one pointer line per moved block"); they are history, not a pin, and are left as they are (outside this slice's surface).

## Token ratchet

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` :: exit 0

| Row | main 7e8b31ce5 | this PR | ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6656 | 6654 | 6665 (unchanged) |
| `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` | 6182 | 6170 | 6188 (unchanged) |

Both rows shrink; no ceiling is raised. The four new index entries cost most of what the data stubs freed. Ceilings are not lowered here, since the ratchet printed no lowering instruction and the script is outside this slice's surface.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 46 commands at head b11a7347 (a968f8ea plus a merge of `origin/main` e0a78783 that touches no `skills/` path). 45 exit 0; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3, NOT MEASURED (needs every package's `dist`; CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran` exit 0: 46 derived, 45 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Four gates first exited 3 on missing builds and passed after building their prerequisites: `check:doc-formula-expressions` (formula, lint), and `check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, which then swept the partial build only. Outside the derived list: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exit 0 (343 examples; no block is marked or changed here) and `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0. Record: `/mnt/project-files/card-31112/s7-gates-b11a7347.txt`.
